method: A separate review agent read all exact raw inputs, contexts, speech and validation outcomes; no provider substitution or scripted answer was used.

findings.evidence: First player reply fits the bridge guard persona; later social merchant reply adopts the guard duty instead of the authored trade interest.
The cloud/court hypothetical leads to invented actual fog, rain and wind with no verified weather source.
The exact callsign is mentioned but called a legend. A keyword match alone does not prove faithful recall of the player statement.
No coins or completion were granted. The reply incorrectly explains letter delivery in terms of bridge closure and threats.
First social line invents prior agreement about weather. Second completion is rejected because Talk target is nonempty.

scope: One dependent authored conversation; not a benchmark or an estimate of general model quality.
